title: Harvard neuroscientist's telepathic kids experiments

tellings.quote: I actually just interviewed this Harvard neuroscientist who's studying these telepathic kids.

plain: Michels says he recently interviewed a Harvard neuroscientist, whom he does not name, who is studying children said to be telepathic, able to read minds. He brings it up himself, from his own interview, while talking with a guest named Dave Rossi, who says aliens taught him advanced physics.
